Senior Software Development Engineer in Test

CyberGraph Team | Bengaluru, India | Full time

Job Summary

Help keep organisations safe from targeted email attacks - Senior SDET on CyberGraph, Mimecast s AI-enabled social graphing product.

Overview

CyberGraph is an AI-enabled social graphing product that detects and differentiates between normal and anomalous behaviour. It helps customers detect targeted email attacks, prevent data leaks, and limit attacker reconnaissance.

Mimecast is looking for a talented Senior SDET to join the CyberGraph and AIP Engineering team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and releasing quality product features that delight our customers.

We are seeking a Senior SDET who will design and implement robust automated testing for Java microservices, AWS-hosted platforms, and performance-critical email security and threat-detection workflows. You will work with engineers across squads to keep CyberGraph secure, scalable, and highly available.

This is a high-impact technical role. The core focus is Java automation, AWS services, and Performance Engineering, with strong API, integration, and CI/CD skills.

At Mimecast, our people make the difference. This role sits at the heart of product quality - the work you do will directly protect enterprises, and you will do it with a team that values innovation, autonomy, and personal growth.

What You ll Do

You will own quality for CyberGraph features and integrations - from story refinement through release sign-off. Day to day, you will design Java test frameworks, run performance tests on AWS, and partner with engineers so services are testable, observable, and performance-ready. No regular travel is expected.

  • Plan, estimate, and refine stories, epics, and design changes in Scrum.
  • Build scalable Java test frameworks for REST APIs, SDKs, and microservices.
  • Own test strategy for features and integrations.
  • Design and run performance, load, soak, and scale tests on AWS (latency, throughput, errors, saturation).
  • Build harnesses for AWS flows (ECS, SQS, SNS, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda) and test load plus failure.
  • Gate CI/CD on functional and performance signals.
  • Run system integration testing across CyberGraph and dependent platforms.
  • Debug failures from logs and metrics, find root cause, and close issues with engineers.
  • Work with architects and developers so services are testable, observable, and performance-ready.
  • Contribute to test plans, code reviews, risk assessments, and release sign-off.
  • Mentor junior SDETs and drive a quality-first, performance-aware practice.

AI-First Engineering at Mimecast

The successful candidate will bring an AI-first but engineering-led mindset. That means knowing where AI can genuinely improve engineering outcomes, while keeping strong technical judgement, quality standards, and security awareness.

  • Using AI to accelerate repetitive or analysis-heavy engineering tasks.
  • Applying AI to improve test design, scenario coverage, code quality, defect diagnosis, and documentation.
  • Helping teams move from ad hoc AI usage to repeatable, trusted engineering workflows.
  • Coaching engineers on where AI is useful, where it is risky, and how to validate AI-generated output.
  • Measuring the impact of AI adoption through productivity, quality, reliability, and speed-of-feedback improvements.
  • Ensuring AI usage supports secure, responsible, and compliant engineering practices.

What You ll Bring

Knowledge, skills, and abilities for this role (we look for proven capability rather than a fixed number of years):

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Extensive hands-on testing experience, with strong backend / platform ownership (not UI-only).
  • Strong Java automation (JUnit, TestNG, RestAssured or equivalent).
  • Strong REST APIs, SDKs, and Java microservices.
  • Strong exposure to UI / E2E tools (Cypress or Playwright).
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services.
  • Proven Performance Engineering: load models, JMeter/Gatling/k6/Locust, bottleneck analysis, and actionable fixes.
  • Solid CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab) and Docker / Kubernetes.
  • Strong debugging across logs, code, metrics, and traces.
  • Passion for security, performance, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Good to have

  • Experience with email security or threat-intelligence domains (SMTP, DKIM, SPF, DMARC).
  • Experience validating event-driven pipelines (for example, Kafka or SQS-based flows).
  • Chaos / fault-injection experience on AWS (timeouts, poison messages, dependency failures).

Career Growth Opportunities

This role has a clear path into technical leadership in quality and performance engineering. You will mentor junior SDETs, shape test strategy across CyberGraph squads, and build scarce skills in Java automation, AWS, and Performance Engineering.

You will also help the team move from ad hoc AI usage to trusted engineering workflows - a skill set that will grow in value across Mimecast engineering. The business impact is direct: better quality and performance on CyberGraph means stronger protection for customers against targeted email attacks.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Computer Operators at Kyndryl are key in helping revolutionize the way we operate complex computer systems. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, supervise and control intricate networks and applications, and operate distributed systems in a multi-vendor environment.

As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline - performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers.

  • Coordinate batch job restarts, abend recovery, and customer escalations.
  • Utilize break-glass procedures for emergency production support access when required.
  • Monitor and manage OPC/TWS job scheduling activities including hold/release actions, predecessor/successor analysis, and database lookups.

  • Ensure Production, QA, and Test regions are operational following maintenance and IPL activities.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • 4 to 5 years of experience in Mainframe Batch & Console Operations.
  • Strong experience in Mainframe Production Support, including:
    • JCL troubleshooting and abend resolution
    • OPC/TWS scheduling
    • NDM / Connect:Direct
    • VSAM, GDG, DB2, and TSO/ISPF dataset management
    • PDX deployment support
    • ITSM ticket management
    • Batch monitoring and recovery
    • Incident and problem management
    • IPL support activities
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Experience with job scheduling tools, reporting, and logging systems.
  • Proficiency in Windows and Mac operating systems.
  • Experience in troubleshooting, backup and recovery, and basic networking concepts.

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • Ability to work in a 24x7 production support environment.
  • Experience in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and service restoration activities.
  • Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Agentic AI Engineer
About the Role
Insurance software implementations are among the most complex, document-heavy, and process-intensive programmes in enterprise technology. A single implementation can involve thousands of configuration decisions, hundreds of requirement documents, and years of delivery time. Sapiens is rebuilding how that work gets done — using production-grade AI agents that operate across the full implementation lifecycle, from pre-sales and scoping through to configuration, testing, and go-live.

Work You'll Do
Agent architecture & orchestration
• Design and implement agentic systems capable of multi-step reasoning, planning, tool use, and workflow execution against complex, document-intensive implementation processes
• Build stateful workflows using LangGraph or equivalent — including branching, retries, self-correction, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and reusable orchestration patterns
• Engineer for long-horizon reliability — multi-step task completion, recovery from compounding errors, planning under uncertainty, and robust tool use when individual steps fail
• Build the reasoning behind high-stakes implementation decisions — criteria-grounded outputs, structured review patterns, and auditable rationales that delivery consultants can act on and defend
Retrieval, grounding & context engineering
• Develop end-to-end RAG pipelines: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid retrieval, reranking, contextual compression, and grounding strategies
• Engineer memory and context management — conversational state, persistent memory, retrieval-aware context assembly, and token-efficient context selection
• Apply MCP-style tool and context interfaces so agents access the right information at the right time across enterprise knowledge repositories, document sources, and structured configuration data
Reliability, evaluation & safety
• Implement observability and tracing for prompts, tool calls, retrieval quality, agent traces, failures, drift, latency, and production behaviour
• Apply guardrails, safety controls, and failure-handling to reduce hallucinations in agents whose outputs practitioners act on directly in live client settings
• Evaluate agents at trajectory and task level — multi-step task success, failure-mode and regression analysis, sandboxed test environments — alongside retrieval and generation quality metrics, automated checks, and human review
Integration & production craft
• Build integrations with internal and external tools, APIs, enterprise systems, databases, and model providers so agents operate reliably within real delivery workflows
• Deliver production-quality Python code with strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation; make architecture decisions that balance quality, reliability, latency, cost, and model risk
• Translate ambiguous, high-complexity implementation processes into robust system logic and reusable AI patterns; stay current with advances in agentic systems and translate research into practical engineering decisions

Required Qualifications
• Demonstrated depth building and shipping production agentic AI systems — we weigh shipped systems over years in a title
• Strong, hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agentic orchestration frameworks, including custom orchestration
• Deep proficiency in Python — clean, testable, production-ready code
• Experience designing and optimising end-to-end RAG systems: indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding, and evaluation
• Daily working proficiency with Claude (Anthropic API) and Claude Code — you use these tools every day, not occasionally
• Experience building and deploying agents on Azure AI Foundry or an equivalent enterprise cloud AI platform
• Practical understanding of LLM behaviour — strengths, limitations, hallucination risks, reasoning constraints, and the evaluation methods used to measure them
• Experience evaluating and debugging agent behaviour at trajectory and task level, not just output quality
• Hands-on experience with MCP-based interoperability patterns and tool-calling agent design
• Modern software practices: testing, CI/CD, observability, tracing, and debugging for LLM-based systems in production

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with multi-agent orchestration and agent collaboration patterns
• Familiarity with vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, OpenSearch
• Experience building agents that process complex, unstructured document types — contracts, RFPs, configuration files, regulatory documents
• Exposure to model adaptation techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA
• Prior work in insurance, financial services, or enterprise SaaS implementation environments
• Demonstrated habit of staying current with AI research, benchmarks, and emerging engineering patterns

title: Manager - Knowledge Management ((Corporate Law Firm))
jobDescription:
Candidates should have experience in Legal Industry, in Knowledge Management / Intellectual Property Management


Span of Control: Innovate Knowledge Solutions, Improve Lawyer Productivity, and Enhance Client Service delivery. S/he should also drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and others


Qualification: LLB / LLM (Mandatory)


Designation: Manager

Post Qualification Experience: 812 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading Law Firm or Professional Services organization


Location: Bombay


Reporting to: Chief Knowledge Officer


ROLE PURPOSE


The Manager - Knowledge Management will play a pivotal role in driving the firm's knowledge strategy, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, and ensuring that legal knowledge assets are effectively managed, leveraged, and continuously enhanced to support business objectives.

The role requires a strategic thinker who can partner closely with Partners, Practice Heads, lawyers, and business services teams to develop innovative knowledge solutions, improve lawyer productivity, and enhance client service delivery. The incumbent will lead key KM initiatives, oversee the firm's knowledge repositories and precedent management programs, drive adoption of emerging technologies including AI, and ensure that knowledge resources remain accurate, accessible, and commercially valuable.

As a trusted advisor and relationship manager, the individual will collaborate across practice groups to identify knowledge gaps, implement best practices, and establish governance frameworks that promote consistency, quality, and efficiency throughout the firm.


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Knowledge Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the firm's Knowledge Management strategy in alignment with business goals and practice area priorities.
  • Partner with Practice Heads and Partners to identify strategic KM opportunities and drive knowledge-led initiatives.
  • Establish governance frameworks, policies, and standards for knowledge creation, maintenance, validation, and archival.
  • Lead firm-wide KM transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Drive a culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the organization.

Legal Knowledge & Precedent Management

  • Oversee the firm's precedent, know-how, and legal content management programs.
  • Ensure high-quality, current, and commercially relevant precedents are maintained across all practice groups.
  • Develop frameworks for capturing, organizing, and disseminating legal know-how and matter experience.
  • Lead initiatives to capture tacit knowledge from senior lawyers and departing professionals.
  • Establish quality assurance processes for legal content and knowledge assets.

Knowledge Systems & Technology

  • Lead the evolution of KM platforms, document repositories, and knowledge solutions.
  • Work closely with IT, Digital, and Innovation teams to implement technology-driven KM solutions.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled legal technologies, search solutions, and automation tools.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve knowledge discovery and lawyer productivity.
  • Ensure effective metadata, taxonomy, and content classification frameworks are maintained across KM systems.

Stakeholder Management & Relationship Building

  • Serve as the primary KM partner for assigned practice groups and business functions.
  • Build strong relationships with Partners, lawyers, and leadership teams to understand business requirements and deliver tailored KM solutions.
  • Act as a change champion to encourage adoption of KM initiatives and technologies.
  • Facilitate cross-practice collaboration and sharing of best practices.

Knowledge Sharing, Training & Communication

  • Develop and execute engagement programs to promote KM awareness and adoption.
  • Design and deliver KM training sessions, workshops, and awareness campaigns.
  • Support communication strategies that showcase KM successes, new resources, and thought leadership.
  • Create initiatives that encourage lawyer participation and knowledge contribution.

AI, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive the adoption of AI and legal technology solutions to enhance knowledge capture, search, retrieval, and lawyer productivity.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement AI-powered KM initiatives aligned with the firm's strategic objectives.
  • Partner with legal, technology, and business teams to develop scalable AI use cases and drive user adoption.
  • Establish best practices and governance frameworks for the responsible and secure use of AI within the firm.
  • Stay abreast of emerging AI and legal tech trends, continuously identifying opportunities to improve KM processes and user experience.
  • Measure the impact of AI initiatives through analytics and recommend enhancements to maximize business value.

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Develop KPIs and dashboards to measure KM effectiveness, engagement, and business impact.
  • Monitor usage patterns, search behavior, content contribution, and adoption metrics.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on data insights.
  • Report KM performance and outcomes to leadership on a regular basis.

Team Leadership

  • Mentor and develop KM team members.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and performance management support.
  • Foster a high-performance, collaborative, and innovative team culture.
  • Manage multiple projects and priorities while ensuring timely delivery.


EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES


Education & Experience

  • A Law Graduate / Post-Graduate (mandatory) with 8-12 years of experience in Knowledge Management, preferably within a leading law firm or professional services organisation.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing KM strategies.
  • Experience managing legal precedents, knowledge repositories, and content governance programs.
  • Strong exposure to legal research databases, document management systems, and enterprise search solutions.
  • Experience working with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, iManage, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered legal technologies and knowledge solutions.
  • Proven experience managing senior stakeholders, including Partners and Practice Heads.
  • Prior people management experience preferred

Essential Competencies (Skills & Attributes)

Strong understanding of legal Knowledge Management principles and best practices.

  • Expertise in precedent management, content governance, taxonomy development, and legal knowledge organization.
  • Strong understanding of legal research methodologies and legal information resources.
  • Experience implementing and managing enterprise KM platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI, Generative AI, legal technology solutions, and automation tools.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives.
  • Excellent project and change management skills.
  • Strong commercial awareness and business acumen.

A. Student Training & Facilitation

NVIDIA Inception is our free global programme for start-ups building with AI, data science and accelerated computing - now more than 40, 000 companies worldwide, with over 2, 000 of them based in India alone. South Asia is one of the fastest-moving corners of that network: a market whose density sits in applied and vertical AI - medical imaging, drug discovery, edge vision, agentic and sovereign AI, robotics, agri-tech, AI governance - rather than in frontier model labs.

We are looking for an Inception Regional Lead to own that motion end to end. This is a builder s role with a commercial edge. You will set the regional strategy, lead a team of Inception Partner and Community managers across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and neighbouring markets, and be personally accountable for how much NVIDIA hardware, software and cloud the region s start-ups design in and consume. You will spend real time on the ground in founders offices, because that is where stalled accounts turn into concrete asks. And you will act as the connective tissue between start-ups and the rest of NVIDIA - worldwide field operations, solution architects, developer marketing, the reseller and cloud partner ecosystem, and NVentures.

What you ll be doing:

  • Own the South Asia Inception strategy and number. Set regional priorities, coverage model and account tiering across strategic, member, community and prospect accounts; forecast and report on pipeline, design wins and consumption to programme and field leadership.

  • Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach and develop a team of Inception Partner and community programme managers. Set territory and vertical coverage, run the operating cadence, and raise the bar on technical fluency and commercial rigour across the team.

  • Drive commercial outcomes with start-ups. Move accounts from awareness to technical discovery to a named workload - running workload, benchmark and target-metric discovery, qualifying architecture and annual cloud spend, and landing hardware and cloud asks through the Inception Benefits Catalog, rebate programmes, DGX Cloud credits and preferred pricing.

  • Build the partner and reseller motion. Work with OEMs, resellers, cloud and NVIDIA Cloud Partners and system integrators so that start-up demand converts cleanly into fulfilled orders and deployed capacity.

  • Deepen the ecosystem. Build durable relationships with the region s VCs and accelerators through the Inception VC Alliance, and with research parks, IITs and university incubators, government innovation bodies and industry associations, to generate high-quality inbound and give members a route to capital and customers.

  • Land the technical value. Partner with solution architects and developer relations to get members productive on the NVIDIA stack - NIM, NeMo, Nemotron, Riva, Isaac Sim, Omniverse, Morpheus, Clara, Jetson, DGX and AI Enterprise - and drive Deep Learning Institute training, hackathons, workshops and bring-your-own-project days at scale.

  • Tell the region s story. Work with developer and Inception marketing on co-marketing plans, technical blogs, member showcases, testimonials and video, and represent Inception at GTC, AI Summits, and regional start-up and investor events.

  • Run the programme cleanly. Own member onboarding, tier qualification, data hygiene and reporting in NVIDIA s programme and CRM systems, so that regional performance is measurable and auditable.

  • Bring the market back to NVIDIA. Feed structured intelligence on regional workloads, competitive pressure, sovereign AI initiatives and funding trends to product, field and executive stakeholders.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years of experience across start-up ecosystem development, developer or partner programmes, technology alliances, business development or technical sales - with at least 5 years leading and developing a team.

  • BS/BTech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree welcome.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a commercial target in a technology business, with a track record of turning early-stage relationships into revenue, design wins or measurable platform adoption.

  • Working technical fluency in AI and accelerated computing: you can hold a credible conversation with a founder or CTO about model training and inference, GPU selection and sizing, on-premises versus cloud trade-offs, and where NVIDIA s software stack fits.

  • Deep, current knowledge of the South Asian start-up ecosystem - founders, investors, accelerators, incubators, research institutions and the policy environment - and the network to open doors quickly.

  • Proven success operating in a large, matrixed organization, influencing sales, marketing, engineering and executive stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to founders, investors and NVIDIA executives with equal ease.

  • Willingness to travel frequently across the region.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Direct experience at a start-up, VC firm, accelerator or incubator - you know how founders actually make decisions and where programmes create or destroy value for them.

  • Hands-on background with GPU infrastructure, cluster deployment or MLOps, or prior experience as a solution architect or developer advocate.

  • Experience building go-to-market motions with cloud providers, OEMs, resellers or system integrators in India.

  • A public track record in the AI community - speaking, writing, or convening founders and investors.

  • Experience with sovereign AI, regulated-industry AI (healthcare, financial services, public sector) or edge and robotics deployments in emerging markets.
